options.explanation: Incorrect. The profit percentage is 12.5%.
Correct. The profit percentage is 12.5%.
Incorrect. The profit percentage is 12.5%.
Incorrect. The profit percentage is 12.5%.

questions.explanation: Profit = Selling price - Cost price = 900 - 800 = 100. Profit percentage = (Profit / Cost price) * 100 = (100 / 800) * 100 = 12.5%.
questions.hint: Calculate the profit first, then find the percentage relative to the cost price.

questions.question: A shopkeeper marks the price of a toy 15% above the cost price. If the cost price is Rs. 120, what is the marked price?

options.explanation: Incorrect. The marked price is Rs. 138.
Correct. The marked price is Rs. 138.
Incorrect. The marked price is Rs. 138.
Incorrect. The marked price is Rs. 138.

questions.explanation: The marked price is 15% above the cost price. So, the marked price = Cost price + 15% of Cost price = 120 + 0.15 * 120 = 120 + 18 = 138.
questions.hint: Calculate 15% of the cost price and add it to the cost price.

questions.question: रवि ने एक खिलौना ₹80 में खरीदा और उसे ₹95 में बेच दिया। रवि को कितना लाभ या हानि हुई?

options.explanation: हानि तब होती है जब विक्रय मूल्य क्रय मूल्य से कम हो। यहाँ विक्रय मूल्य अधिक है।
विक्रय मूल्य (₹95) क्रय मूल्य (₹80) से ₹15 अधिक है, अतः लाभ ₹15 हुआ।
विक्रय मूल्य क्रय मूल्य से अधिक है, अतः हानि नहीं हुई।

questions.explanation: खिलौने का क्रय मूल्य (CP) = ₹80, विक्रय मूल्य (SP) = ₹95। चूंकि SP > CP, अतः लाभ हुआ। लाभ = SP - CP = ₹95 - ₹80 = ₹15।
questions.hint: क्रय मूल्य और विक्रय मूल्य के अंतर से लाभ या हानि ज्ञात करें।
